review.images: Extracted architecture, private interiors and shared amenities from Aldar’s Fahid Beach Residences brochure. Aldar uses several bedroom, kitchen and bathroom renders in both Fahid brochures. Those shared scenes were omitted so the gallery represents this release.
review.location: Physical page 7 contains the island location diagram and all five journey estimates. The full map panel on the left is displayed, with the source PDF linked. No building entrance coordinate was verified.
review.floorPlans: All 14 residence examples across eight physical spreads on pages 29–36 were visually checked. The source uses two layouts per spread except pages 29 and 36. Preserved full source pages and kept these drawings separate from Fahid Beach Terraces.

unavailable: Confirmed tower entrances and drawing-specific total areas.
